name: Bright Scholarship

extractionHints.detail: Each scholarship post states degree level/coverage/eligible nationality/deadline in a summary table plus prose, and usually links an 'Official Link' — that link is the officialSourceUrl candidate for verification, always worth fetching directly rather than trusting this source's own restatement of the facts.

notes: DISCOVERY authority only. Seed post (Belgium Government ARES Scholarship 2027-28) confirmed real and reachable (2026-08-10); its stated 'Official Link' (ares-ac.be) was independently fetched and corroborates the deadline exactly (18 September 2026) with a largely-overlapping but not identical eligible-country list — a genuine real-world example of partial corroboration, handled by lib/verification/flagConflicts.ts rather than silently merged.
